Collaborate with development and operations teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues. Implement best practices for infrastructure management and application monitoring. Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in infrastructure management and application performance monitoring. Familiarity with Dev Ops practices and tools. Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation tasks. Certifications in relevant technologies or methodologies (e.g., ITIL, PMP).

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 5 7 years of experience in infrastructure management with a focus on application performance monitoring. Proven track record of successfully managing complex IT infrastructure projects.
